summary: Iteration 19 — Backend onboarding backfill v2 fully verified (36/36 pytest pass) against preview URL. Frontend UI verification is BLOCKED by an environment-skew issue: the deployed Expo bundle hardcodes API_BASE_URL to https://bug-busters-13.emergent.host (logged as 'API_BASE_URL = https://bug-busters-13.emergent.host'), which is a DIFFERENT backend than the preview URL where backfill v2 ran. A user registered directly against that production backend returns tips_state: None on /api/users/me — i.e. no v2 backfill / no register-time init applied there. As a result the new OnboardingOverlay testids never render in the UI and the legacy chip-style 'Share with the community' floating tip is what actually appears. Additionally the create-post screen crashes on first navigation with 'TypeError: Notifications.removeNotificationSubscription is not a function' (NotificationInitializer) before recovering on subsequent loads.

ui_bugs.issue: OnboardingOverlay (Tip 3) not rendering. After login + navigation to /create-post (with and without workoutStats), none of the new testids appear: onboarding-overlay-pointer-0/1/2, onboarding-overlay-bottom-bar, onboarding-overlay-never-show. Instead, a legacy small floating chip 'Share with the community / Don't show again' shows in the top-right.

ig-share-button testid not present on /create-post even when workoutStats query param is passed. The IG button is gated on `workoutStats` state (line 1745) which is set from JSON.parse of params.workoutStats — this may need a different param shape than what we passed, OR the render path is being suppressed by the onboarding-overlay race / NotificationInitializer crash.

Could not visually assert the 'Choose your MOOD' touchable + scale-pulse — Terms & Privacy splash blocks home on every fresh-token reload (locks behind user gesture). Testid not exposed for the wrapper Touchable so we cannot confirm via Playwright.

First navigation to /create-post crashes with 'TypeError: Notifications.removeNotificationSubscription is not a function' — entry.bundle line ~117737. Recovers on retry/reload but causes one-time UX failure right when overlay/IG button should mount.

integration_issues.issue: Expo bundle reads Constants.expoConfig?.extra.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL = https://bug-busters-13.emergent.host (production override) instead of the runtime preview URL. /api/auth/register against that production backend returns no tips_state in /users/me (tips_state: None). v2 backfill / register-time init code is NOT live on the backend that the frontend actually talks to. This makes Tip 2 / Tip 3 trigger conditions (form_videos == 'unseen', completion_share == 'unseen') unreachable for the user the UI is logged in as, even though the spec asserts backfill v2 'matched=91 users'.

action_items: PRIMARY: Reconcile the Expo build's hardcoded production URL (bug-busters-13.emergent.host) with the backend that actually runs the v2 backfill. Either (a) deploy server.py with backfill-v2 code to bug-busters-13.emergent.host and restart it, or (b) remove the production-URL override so the app uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL at runtime. Until then NO frontend onboarding tip will render against a real logged-in user.

Investigate NotificationInitializer crash 'Notifications.removeNotificationSubscription is not a function' on first /create-post navigation — likely SDK API rename in expo-notifications. Wrap the unsubscribe call in feature-detect: `if (sub?.remove) sub.remove();` instead of calling Notifications.removeNotificationSubscription(sub).
Add data-testid to the 'Choose your MOOD' TouchableOpacity wrapper (e.g. mood-section-touchable) so the new pulse-animation + tap-to-scroll affordance is testable.

Verify OnboardingOverlay actually receives `visible={true}` after 800ms by adding a console.log in `requestRender('completion_share')` — once the env is fixed, re-run the same Playwright probe to assert the 5 new testids.
critical_code_review_comments: create-post.tsx remains 3140 lines — long-standing technical-debt warning unchanged from iter-17/18.

OnboardingOverlay rendering is gated on `completionTipActive` which depends on `tips_state.completion_share === 'unseen'`. With prod backend not initializing tips_state, the overlay never activates — same root cause as Tip 2 not rendering on workout-session.

The IG button is gated on `workoutStats` truthy (line 1745). We passed `?workoutStats=<json>` and it still didn't render — likely the JSON.parse path needs `workouts` items with specific keys (workoutSnapshotId etc). Worth adding a developer-mode escape hatch testid for the IG button to make it Playwright-testable without a full workout completion.

The 'Rejecting preview env URL — using production' override is a footgun: backend tests pass on preview URL while frontend invisibly talks to a different host. Recommend removing this override or at minimum surfacing it in a banner during dev/test.

rca of the issue: Root cause for 'overlay does not render in UI': the deployed Expo bundle's API_BASE_URL points to https://bug-busters-13.emergent.host (production), but the v2 onboarding backfill (server.py:12727-12748) and register-time tips_state initialization were verified ONLY on https://live-feed-preview.preview.emergentagent.com. Direct probe: POST https://bug-busters-13.emergent.host/api/auth/register → 200, then GET /api/users/me → tips_state: None (no key set). Therefore the frontend's `onboarding.requestRender('completion_share')` short-circuits because tips_state is missing/non-'unseen'. Mitigation: rebuild/deploy server.py to bug-busters-13.emergent.host (or remove the EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL production override in app.json/eas config so it uses the runtime preview URL). Independent secondary RCA — the NotificationInitializer crash is a SDK API mismatch: expo-notifications no longer exposes `removeNotificationSubscription` as a static; the recommended pattern is `subscription.remove()`.
